## Chat
- Gemini 4 Neon and Gemini 4 Hydrogen join the chat model lineup. Gemini 4 Argon is retired; if you had it selected, Chat switches your saved choice to Neon automatically.
- When a light model (such as 3.8 Flash, Flash Lite, GPT mini/Luna, Haiku, Grok 4.3, or a local model) is about to change the app's settings, Chat shows a warning card above the approval card. One click switches to your strongest model with a key and resends the message.

## Dictate Prompt
- Two larger on-device models, Qwen3.5 9B and Gemma 4 26B A4B, are now offered in the Dictate Prompt model picker instead of being hidden as chat-only. Their descriptions explain why they aren't recommended over the default.

## Pill
- The recording pill now shows a drag grip — six small dots at its leading edge, with an open-hand cursor on hover and a "Drag to move" tooltip — so it's clear the pill can be repositioned.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v9.05...v9.06
